component.name: WhisperWriter
component.summary: Speech-to-text voice typing powered by OpenAI Whisper

description.p: WhisperWriter is a speech-to-text desktop application that runs in the background and automatically transcribes your speech into the currently active window. Activate it with a keyboard shortcut, speak, and your words are typed out.

Transcription can be performed locally using the faster-whisper engine with models ranging from tiny to large-v3-turbo, or via the OpenAI API. Supports multiple recording modes including continuous dictation, voice activity detection, press-to-toggle, and hold-to-record.

ul.li: Multiple Whisper model sizes including turbo and distilled variants

description.p: Major update with modernized packaging and model support:

ul.li: Added large-v3-turbo, turbo, and distilled model variants
Upgraded faster-whisper to 1.2.1 with Silero VAD V6
Added new quantization types (bfloat16, int8_float16, int8_bfloat16)
Linux packaging: .deb, PKGBUILD (Arch/AUR), and Flatpak support

description.p: Migrated to faster-whisper, added evdev/ydotool/dotool input backends.
